From 6557004a8b59c7701e695f02be03c7e20ed1cc15 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Josh Law <objecting@objecting.org>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 10:54:26 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] mm/damon/sysfs: check contexts->nr in repeat_call_fn

damon_sysfs_repeat_call_fn() calls damon_sysfs_upd_tuned_intervals(),
damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_stats(), and
damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_effective_quotas() without checking contexts->nr.
If nr_contexts is set to 0 via sysfs while DAMON is running, these
functions dereference contexts_arr[0] and cause a NULL pointer
dereference.  Add the missing check.

For example, the issue can be reproduced using DAMON sysfs interface and
DAMON user-space tool (damo) [1] like below.

    $ sudo damo start --refresh_interval 1s
    $ echo 0 | sudo tee \
            /sys/kernel/mm/damon/admin/kdamonds/0/contexts/nr_contexts

Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260320163559.178101-3-objecting@objecting.org
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/20260321175427.86000-4-sj@kernel.org
Link: https://github.com/damonitor/damo [1]
Fixes: d809a7c64ba8 ("mm/damon/sysfs: implement refresh_ms file internal work")
Signed-off-by: Josh Law <objecting@objecting.org>
Reviewed-by: SeongJae Park <sj@kernel.org>
Signed-off-by: SeongJae Park <sj@kernel.org>
Cc: <stable@vger.kernel.org>	[6.17+]
Signed-off-by: Andrew Morton <akpm@linux-foundation.org>

diff --git a/mm/damon/sysfs.c b/mm/damon/sysfs.c
index ddc30586c0e6..6a44a2f3d8fc 100644
--- a/mm/damon/sysfs.c
+++ b/mm/damon/sysfs.c
@@ -1620,9 +1620,12 @@ static int damon_sysfs_repeat_call_fn(void *data)
 
 	if (!mutex_trylock(&damon_sysfs_lock))
 		return 0;
+	if (sysfs_kdamond->contexts->nr != 1)
+		goto out;
 	damon_sysfs_upd_tuned_intervals(sysfs_kdamond);
 	damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_stats(sysfs_kdamond);
 	damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_effective_quotas(sysfs_kdamond);
+out:
 	mutex_unlock(&damon_sysfs_lock);
 	return 0;
 }
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File Changes

**`mm/damon/sysfs.c`**  
- Modified the function `damon_sysfs_repeat_call_fn()` by adding a guard condition before calling three update functions:  
  `damon_sysfs_upd_tuned_intervals()`, `damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_stats()`, and `damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_effective_quotas()`.  
- The new check verifies that `sysfs_kdamond->contexts->nr` equals 1. If not, the three update calls are skipped, and execution jumps directly to the `out` label where `mutex_unlock` occurs.

### Relationships

- The bug occurred because `damon_sysfs_repeat_call_fn()` assumed at least one context existed (`contexts_arr[0]`), but a race condition (writing `0` to the sysfs `nr_contexts` file while DAMON was running) could set `nr_contexts` to 0. This caused a NULL pointer dereference when the update functions accessed the first context.
- The patch adds a safety check that prevents the three update functions from being invoked when no contexts are present (`nr != 1`). This eliminates the possibility of accessing invalid memory. The `contexts->nr == 1` condition is appropriate because the DAMON sysfs interface is designed to manage a single context per kdamond in this path (the repeat call function is part of periodic refresh logic that expects exactly one active context).

dereference.  Add the missing check.

For example, the issue can be reproduced using DAMON sysfs interface and
DAMON user-space tool (damo) [1] like below.

    $ sudo damo start --refresh_interval 1s
    $ echo 0 | sudo tee \
            /sys/kernel/mm/damon/admin/kdamonds/0/contexts/nr_contexts

Here is the root cause:
The function damon_sysfs_repeat_call_fn() in mm/damon/sysfs.c calls damon_sysfs_upd_tuned_intervals(), damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_stats(), and damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_effective_quotas() without first checking that contexts->nr is non-zero (specifically 1, as expected in this path). When the sysfs file nr_contexts is set to 0 while DAMON is running, contexts->nr becomes 0, and these functions attempt to dereference contexts_arr[0], which is NULL, causing a NULL pointer dereference.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int damon_sysfs_repeat_call_fn(void *data)
 {
 	struct damon_sysfs_kdamond *sysfs_kdamond = data;
 
 	if (!sysfs_kdamond->refresh_ms)
 		return 0;
 	if (time_before(jiffies, damon_sysfs_next_update_jiffies))
 		return 0;
 	damon_sysfs_next_update_jiffies = jiffies +
 		msecs_to_jiffies(sysfs_kdamond->refresh_ms);
 
 	if (!mutex_trylock(&damon_sysfs_lock))
 		return 0;
+	if (sysfs_kdamond->contexts->nr != 1)
+		goto out;
 	damon_sysfs_upd_tuned_intervals(sysfs_kdamond);
 	damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_stats(sysfs_kdamond);
 	damon_sysfs_upd_schemes_effective_quotas(sysfs_kdamond);
+out:
 	mutex_unlock(&damon_sysfs_lock);
 	return 0;
 }
